verdict.rationale: Galileo documents Experiments that evaluate prompts, models, and application code against chosen metrics on well-defined inputs. Experiments can be created from the console or via MCP. That is the raw material for regression checks between prompt or model versions, but no evidence shows a side-by-side run comparison view or diffing. Missing for 10: a documented side-by-side experiment comparison UI or API, per-row or per-metric diffs between runs, regression highlighting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
